name: Dubai American Academy Open 2025

venue.name: [GEMS Dubai American Academy](https://www.gemsaa-dubai.com/)
venue.address: Hessa Street - Sheikh Zayed Rd - Al Barsha - Dubai

information:
This event is organized and hosted by [GEMS Dubai American Academy school](https://www.gemsaa-dubai.com/), and to be recognized by the World Cube Association. This event was initiated by it's passionate and enthusiastic students, supervised by school staff representatives and overseen by the WCA Delegate.

Kindly read the competition registration and information carefully.

Please feel free to [contact](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=DubaiAmericanAcademyOpen2025&contactRecipient=competition) the organizing team for any questions.
